career_ladder.note: Officers recruited through the KPSC Gazetted Probationers Examination enter the Karnataka Administrative Service (Junior Scale) or Karnataka Police Service (DySP). Progression to IAS is governed by the Indian Administrative Service (Appointment by Promotion) Regulations through the Karnataka State Cadre induction quota.

exam_scheme.note: The KPSC Gazetted Probationers Examination comprises three successive stages: Preliminary Examination (Objective screening, 400 marks), Main Examination (Descriptive written, 2 qualifying papers + 5 compulsory papers totaling 1250 marks), and Personality Test (Interview, 50 marks).

stages.source_label: KPSC Gazetted Probationers Rules & Preliminary Examination Plan (syll_GP.pdf)

papers.paper_name: Paper 1: General Studies (National & International Current Events, Humanities — Indian History, Indian & World Geography, Indian Polity & Economy)
Paper 2: General Studies (State Significance & Karnataka Schemes, General Science & Tech, Environment & Ecology, General Mental Ability — Class 10th level basic numeracy & logical reasoning)

stages.source_label: Karnataka Recruitment of Gazetted Probationers (Appointment by Competitive Examination) Rules (GP RULES 24-11-2014.pdf)

papers.paper_name: Paper I: Essay (Two essays in Kannada or English — 125 marks each)
Paper II: General Studies 1 (History & Cultural Heritage of India & Karnataka, Social & Political Perspective, Indian & Karnataka Economy)
Paper III: General Studies 2 (Physical Features & Natural Resources, Constitution of India, Public Administration & Governance, International Relations)
Paper IV: General Studies 3 (Role & Impact of Science and Technology in Development of India & Karnataka, Modern Trends in S&T, Environment & Ecology, Mental Ability)
Paper V: General Studies 4 (Ethics, Integrity and Aptitude — Case Studies, Moral Philosophies, Public Service Values)

stages.source_label: Karnataka Gazetted Probationers (Appointment by Competitive Examination) Amendment Rules (Interview marks revised from 200 to 50)

papers.paper_name: Personality Test / Viva-Voce (KPSC Board, Udyoga Soudha, Bengaluru)

financial_package.note: Salary computed as per Karnataka Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules under Karnataka State Pay Commission matrix (Scale ₹52,650–₹97,100 for Group A KAS Junior Scale; Entry Basic Pay ₹52,650). In-hand estimate applies mandatory project constant 58% DA as of 2025-07-01 and city-wise HRA (Bengaluru Zone A at 27%, Class B at 18%, Class C taluk centers at 9%).
financial_package.pay_source_label: KPSC Gazetted Probationers 2026-27 Official Notification and Karnataka Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated with Entry Basic Pay of ₹52,650 at mandatory 58% DA (₹30,537) plus HRA ranging from 9% (₹4,739) in taluk sub-divisions to 27% (₹14,216) in Bengaluru urban limits, less statutory NPS (10% Basic+DA), KGID insurance, and professional tax deductions.
official_perks: Designated official vehicle with driver for official duty and field inspections
Executive government residential quarters or leased accommodation reimbursement
Comprehensive medical coverage for officer and family under Karnataka Government Servants Medical Attendance Rules
Executive mobile telephone and office telephone allowance
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) as per Karnataka State Civil Services rules
National Pension System (NPS) with full 14% matching employer contribution
